t: Congratulations to Inalbek Sheriev, winner of 2026 World Wrestling Championships in Astana
d: Vladimir Putin sent a message of greetings to Inalbek Sheriev, winner of the men’s 74 kg freestyle at the 2026 World Wrestling Championships in Astana.

t: Congratulations to Ibragim Ibragimov, winner of 2026 World Wrestling Championships in Astana
d: Vladimir Putin sent a message of greetings to Ibragim Ibragimov, winner of men’s freestyle 70 kg at the 2026 World Wrestling Championships in Astana.

t: Congratulations to Amanula Gadzhimagomedov, winner of 2026 World Wrestling Championships in Astana
d: Vladimir Putin sent a message of greetings to Amanula Gadzhimagomedov, winner of the men’s freestyle 92 kg at the 2026 World Wrestling Championships in Astana.

t: Meeting of the Council for Interethnic Relations
d: Vladimir Putin chaired a meeting of the Presidential Council for Interethnic Relations at the Kremlin ahead of National Unity Day. The agenda focused on the results of the Year of Unity of the Peoples of Russia.

t: Congratulations to Anton Aristarkhov, winner of 2026 ISSF World Championship in Doha, Qatar
d: Vladimir Putin sent a congratulatory message to Anton Aristarkhov, winner of the men’s 50m pistol event at the 2026 ISSF World Championship in Doha, Qatar.
